title: Chicken Meatballs & Zoodles with Mushroom Sauce
notes: A roux is just 1 part fat or oil to 1.5 parts flour. Use plantain or cassava flour to remain gluten free. Heat the oil over a medium heat until it bubbles when a pinch of flour is thrown in. Add the flour gradually and stir constantly for 5-7 minutes. The finished roux will have a slightly nutty flavour and will have darkened in colour.

ingredientSections.heading: Mushroom Sauce
items: Roux to thicken if desired (plantain or cassava flour and canola oil to remain gluten free)

methodSections.heading: Mushroom Sauce
steps: Sauté the onions, mushrooms and thyme in a saucepan for around 5 minutes or until the onions are soft and the mushrooms have some colour.
Add the vegetable stock and white wine and simmer for 20-30 minutes or until the liquid has reduced by around one-third.
Season with salt, pepper and tamari soy sauce to taste.
To thicken further, add around 100ml of roux, stir well and simmer for around 5 minutes while stirring.

methodSections.heading: Chicken Meatballs
steps: Crack the eggs into a large mixing bowl. Finely chop the parsley and add to the eggs with all the remaining meatball ingredients.
Add the ground chicken and mix well by hand until all the ingredients fully incorporated.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper and brush lightly with canola oil.

Ball the chicken into golf ball-sized balls either using your hands or an ice cream scoop. Rinsing your hands and/or the scoop regularly helps form perfectly round meatballs. Place on the parchment paper.
Bake in the oven for 45 minutes or until the internal temperature is 75°C (165°F).
Allow to cool for a few minutes before serving.
